primary_metric: mean two-class balanced accuracy with equal weight per validation participant
secondary_metrics: confusion counts by participant and class
single_class_policy: retain windows and predictions; report class counts and observed-class recall; two-class metrics are null and excluded from their summaries
selection: pooled inner out-of-fold equal-participant primary metric; first configuration wins exact ties

fixed.scaling: StandardScaler inside kNN/SVM training pipelines only
fixed.PCA: omitted: small interpretable feature sets; preserve position comparison

test_evaluation: forbidden until analysis and model choices are locked
search_budget: 6 configurations x 3 inner folds x 3 outer folds for each model/feature group; no adaptive expansion
